intended_behavior: The method should construct the message dictionary using the role attribute from the BidiTextInputEvent instance instead of hardcoding the role to 'user'. Specifically, change message: Message = {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": event.text}]} to message: Message = {"role": event.role, "content": [{"text": event.text}]}. This respects the event role as intended, allowing different roles such as 'assistant' to be preserved in message history. All other functionality remains unchanged.
